jobs.occupation: Project Assistant (m/f/d) (Projektassistent/in)
jobs.description:
KLIFOVET GmbH, part of the Argenta Group, is a globally recognized supplier in the veterinary and feed sector based in Munich. We have made it our mission to competently accompany customers from the idea, through development, to approval and beyond. The service for our customers determines our actions. Since our founding in 1997, we have been awarded three times as the best service provider and the best contract research organization internationally.

About the role

The commercial project assistant role is a great opportunity to gain development within a dynamic and diverse team. Some of the key tasks you will be involved with are:

- Supporting project managers in the preparation and execution of clinical trials
- Procurement of study materials and office supplies
- Support of the departments in the area of shipping and logistics
- Support for data maintenance and data collection
- Documentation and archiving of study documents
- Labelling, dispensing, and administration of study medication
- First point of contact for customers and service providers on site and by telephone
- General office activities and support of in-house administrative processes

About you

By nature, you are a positive team player, embracing change and flexibility ensuring you are agile to meet the business demands.  You are reliable, and ambitious to learn new skills achieving the best you can in support of your team.

Experience and key skills

- A completed commercial apprenticeship or an apprenticeship in the pharmaceutical/medical field
- Solid knowledge in the use of MS Office programs
- Interest and curiosity to familiarize yourself with new tasks and areas of knowledge
- Independent, reliable and bring structure to your tasks
- Excellent German and English language skills, both written and verbal,  other foreign language skills are an advantage
- Customer-oriented, confident and positive appearance as well as open to having fun working in a team

We offer you a detailed introduction to your field of work, an independent, challenging and varied job, modern work equipment, family-friendly working hours, regular training and further education and a positive and collegial team in an appealing ambience in Munich.

If this sounds like an interesting role to you and you are looking for a new opportunity we would love to hear from you.  Please apply for this role via www.argentaglobal.com/careers

jobs.occupation: Data Center Technician / Strasbourg Grad Est France (Techniker/in - Informatik (technische Informatik)/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
Data Center Technician

R019729
Strasbourg, Grand Est, France
Regular
Apply Now
Location Details: France, Strasburg

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is an in-office position and you’ll be expected to work full-time in an office location, and therefore must live within commuting distance from your assigned office. You will work from this office beginning on your first day.

Join our team

As Data Center Technician will be the technical liaison between the technology teams and the data center environment. You will work a flexible shift 24/7 in a rolling system.

What you'll get to do…

You perform hardware troubleshooting, maintenance as well as data and power cable management, testing, and installation for GoDaddy infrastructure, with a focus on critical systems (storage, network, servers) and you are able to solve all but the most sophisticated infrastructure issues
You maintain documentation on technologies you support and understand all aspects of the equipment
You respond to all requests from 24x7 business operations centers and work according to policies and procedures

You perform Disk Life Cycle process and destruction of data bearing devices following our policies
You coordinate with suppliers to initiate warranty claim and process failed vendor hardware devices
Your experience should include…

Validated expertise in systems administration (Linux and/or Windows Servers) and networking (DNS, DHCP)
1+ years experience with the following IT hardware concepts: RAID, Storage Concept, SAS/SATA/NVME, Boot Process, Boot Loader, Base Operating System Install, Network device and protocol configuration, File Systems, Directory Structure, Core OS Services such as SSH, Telnet, RDP, FTP, NFS, DNS, DHCP, LDAP
The ability to kneel, crawl, reach above shoulder height and lift 25kg repeatedly throughout daily shifts and walk/move about the data center facility for up to 85% of shift time
Verbal and written communication skills in English
You might also have…

Basic Linux OS knowledge
Basic Windows OS knowledge
Basic command line troubleshooting knowledge
We've got your back...  We offer a range of benefits that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in an employee stock purchase plan, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

About us...  GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements. Refer to our full EEO policy.

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

jobs.occupation: System Performance Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

As part of the Satellite Systems Engineering department, the System Performance team is responsible for controlling the system performance of our spacecraft from study phases until commissioning in-orbit. As part of our team, you will work in an inter-disciplinary environment in which you can contribute to the overall system architecture of our space missions, coordinate design and development activities related to space system performance and verify the performance requirements by analyses and tests.

Your Tasks:

In this position, you will work in collaboration with architects and subsystem engineers on tasks like:

- Modelling of the Satellite’s imaging geometry and analysis of the geometric performances
- Pointing performance engineering on subjects like microvibration, thermo-elastic deformation and others.
- Implementation of the performance calibration and development of the associated software tools.
- Performance testing at various levels (Satellite, Platform, Units) including the test evaluation.
- Algorithm development for data processing and simulation focused on satellite level aspects such as geometry.
- Implementation and Maintenance of the Satellite Characterization and Calibration Database used for the on-ground data processing
Your Qualifications

- University degree in physics, aerospace engineering, remote sensing, or similar
- Professional experience in one or more of the following categories is advantageous - Satellite design, in particular optical and/or radar missions
- Design & simulation of control systems, multibody systems, mechanisms or similar
- Geometric performances of Earth observation space missions
- End-to-End Simulation of Earth-Observation and/or Science Data
- Experience in programming (e.g. MATLAB, Python)
- Self-managed, solution-oriented and pro-active working style
- Ability to work in a team
- Working level proficiency in written and spoken English and German. Other language skills advantageous

jobs.occupation: Senior System Engineer for Exploration, In Space Transportation and Servicing (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

As a Senior System Engineer Predevelopment, you will take a leading role in shaping the early phases of cutting‑edge satellite missions. In this position, you will drive system engineering activities during Phase A/B1, provide technical leadership across specialist teams and subcontractors, and steer the definition of the mission and system architecture. You will be responsible to establish the technical, programmatic, and schedule foundations that ensure mission success throughout the entire development lifecycle.

Tasks:

- Act as lead system engineer or senior counterpart to the Lead System Engineer for the Phase A/B1 study.
- Coordinate and oversee technical contributions from specialist engineering departments and subcontractors, ensuring coherence and quality.
- Perform and guide trade-offs and high-level analyses to shape the mission and system architecture.
- Lead substantial elements of the platform and subsystem system design, including deriving, validating, and maintaining requirements from satellite down to subsystem level.
- Contribute to and review the satellite development approach to secure the targeted Technology Readiness Level (TRL) by the end of Phase B1.
- Support and guide the definition of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) for phases B2, C/D, and E1 through in‑orbit commissioning.
- Support the development and consolidation of the programme plan for phases B2, C/D, and E1 up to in-orbit calibration and validation.
- Support and review the establishment of a project implementation schedule for the platform aligned with overall programme planning.
- Analyse and assess cost drivers, contributing to cost modelling and optimization strategies.
- Identify, evaluate, and help manage technical and programmatic risks related to cost, schedule, and technical feasibility.
- Contribute to planning and implementing risk mitigation measures for the platform.
Your Qualifications

Minimum:

- Master-level degree in aerospace engineering with a focus on space systems
- Minimum 5 years of industry experience in space system engineering or satellite development.
- Strong competencies in space mission design, satellite systems engineering, and spacecraft subsystem design.
- Experience in requirements engineering for spacecraft subsystems and preparation of specifications.
- Familiarity with science, exploration, or space safety mission concepts.
- High level of flexibility and ability to work effectively in international, interdisciplinary teams.
- Strong ownership mindset, structured and proactive working approach, and strong sense of responsibility.
- Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
- Fluency in spoken and written (business) English.

Ideal:

- Significant experience working on Phase 0/A/B1 projects and proposals in industry or on institutional side.
- Hands‑on experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) toolchains and methodologies
- Fluency in German language is an advantage

jobs.occupation: Space Safety System Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Project Manager Science, Exploration and Space Safety (m/f/d) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

The Directorate of Predevelopment, Proposals and Space System Studies is a strategic cornerstone of the company’s project pipeline. It drives the early shaping of future space missions by translating customer requirements into technically sound and competitive concepts. Within this directorate, the Department of Science, Exploration and Space Safety Missions focuses on the conceptualisation and maturation of missions related to astrophysics, planetary science, robotic solar system exploration, space safety, planetary defence, space weather, in-orbit servicing, in-space logistics and debris mitigation. By bridging scientific ambition with engineering feasibility, the department plays a key role in securing the OHB’s leadership in future international space programs.

As an experienced and committed Project Manager (m/f/d), you will be responsible for the successful implementation of exciting and complex proposals and projects in the domains of science and space safety in Phases 0/A and B1. You will lead interdisciplinary project teams, ensuring efficient collaboration and optimal performance. You will play a key role in the planning, coordination and management of projects to ensure that they are completed on time, cost-effectively and to the highest quality.

Your Tasks

- Responsible for the project management for proposals and projects in Phases 0/A/B1. Be accountable for the cost, schedule and performance of studies or projects.
- Support the preparation and implementation of mission and system proposals.
- Analysis, definition and agreement of the requirements with the project team and the customer(s). Lead negotiation with customers, potential partners and suppliers.
- Strengthen our relationships with clients, and act as a liaison with key stakeholders in client organisations.
Your Qualifications

- Successful completion of studies in aerospace, engineering, or a related field, demonstrating your expertise in the subject matter.
- Significant projessional experince as project manager for Phase 0/A/B1 projects, preferrably in the domains science, exploration and/or space safety. Significant experience in dealing with ESA as a customer.
- Knowledge of space projects, including systems and operations.
- Proven expertise in crafting compelling proposals
- Passion and knowledge in the space field are not just desirable but form the foundation of our collective success.
Exceptional communication and negotiation skills.
- Strong result orientation, operational efficiency and ability to reach pragmatic and timely decisions.
- Proficiency in English. Fluency in German is an advantage.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager Earth Observation Missions (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)

jobs.occupation: Systems Engineer Satellite Operations (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

At OHB, we take on some of the most exciting challenges in the space industry. We work across a wide spectrum of spacecraft missions — from single satellites to entire constellations, from LEO to interplanetary exploration, supporting customers in Defence, Science, and beyond.

In our Spacecraft Operations Development team, we want to shape the operational concept from day one. We collaborate closely with customers, write the user manuals for the satellites we deliver, develop the flight procedures that will guide operations in orbit, and support the mission from separation through handover — and often long after.

We’re now looking for a passionate and experienced Spacecraft Operations Engineer who’s ready to jump in, get up to speed quickly, and contribute from proposals all the way through Phase E.

If you have hands-on experience creating and validating procedures, if you’ve been part of LEOP and commissioning campaigns, and if you’re excited about influencing earlier mission phases to enable simple, reliable, and robust operations for our customers — we’d love to meet you.
This is your opportunity to leave a meaningful mark on space.
Your Qualifications

Required

- Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a similar technical field.
- 7+ years of experience in Spacecraft Operations Development, such as writing or validating flight procedures, developing operations concepts, creating spacecraft user manuals o supporting pre‑launch and in‑orbit preparation
- Hands-on experience in LEOP and Commissioning (actively participating in real-time ops).
- Strong understanding of spacecraft subsystems (AOCS, Power, TT&C, Thermal, Payload, etc.).
- Experience with Mission Control Systems and ground segment tools (e.g., SCOS‑2000, EGS‑CC, MCS look-alikes, automation frameworks).
- Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Preferred / Nice to have

- Professional proficiency in German (spoken and written).
- Experience supporting phases B/C/D, especially requirements definition, design reviews, and operations preparation.
- Experience with constellations, on‑board automation, or autonomy concepts.
- Understanding of ECSS standards, especially related to operations (E‑70 series).
Experience with simulator testing, procedure automation (e.g., TM/TC scripting), FMECA / hazard analysis from an ops perspective
- Familiarity with project management tools and workflows (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
- Ability to work in customer‑oriented environments (ESA, DLR, defence customers, commercial operators).

Soft Skills (important for the role)

- Strong communication and documentation skills.
- Ability to collaborate with system engineers, AIV teams, and customers.
- Proactive, structured, and able to work independently.
- Problem‑solving mindset, especially under time pressure (LEOP, anomalies).
- Willingness to occasionally travel for reviews, test campaigns, or operations.
